definitions.explanation: Moving, speaking, or acting in an uncertain, unsteady way, often due to inexperience or difficulty.

examples.japanese: たどたどしい{日本語|にほんご}
たどたどしい{足取|あしど}りで{歩|ある}いた。
{子供|こども}がたどたどしく{文字|もじ}を{読|よ}んでいる。
examples.english: The child is reading the letters haltingly.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・たどたどしくない (negative)
・たどたどしく (adverbial form)
・たどたどしかった (past)

ONOMATOPOEIA:
The repetitive たどたど mimics the unsteady, repetitive nature of stumbling or faltering speech/movement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・たどたどしい{日本語|にほんご} - halting Japanese
・たどたどしい{英語|えいご} - broken English
・たどたどしい{足取|あしど}り - faltering steps
・たどたどしく{話|はな}す - to speak haltingly
